But you show me a true atheist, and I will show you one of the most closed-minded people you have ever met.
94031.title: Response Video 1 - "I Know You are, but What am I?" (Shawn McCraney, Heart of the Matter)

94046.context: I love how you declare an idea weighted in the balance and found wanting. Then, by way of explanation, offer us nothing but an anecdote about how you quit believing in Santa Claus but still believe in God. Look, it's great that you grew the skeptical faculties to ask these questions about Santa Claus.
